name: Upright Rope Tricep Pushdown
description: Stand upright facing a high cable with a rope attachment, feet hip width, torso tall and still. Pin the elbows to your ribs with the hands near the chest, then straighten the arms down toward the thighs, splitting the rope apart at the bottom and squeezing the triceps. Let the hands rise slowly back to just below the chest without the elbows drifting forward. No lean, nothing behind the head: only the forearms move. This is the upright version; the lean-back pushdown (`incline-cable-overhead-tricep-extension`) carries the torso backward to put the long head on stretch, and it is a different lift with its own loads.
